questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the run-trigger endpoint tells clients where to find the resource it created? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Why does triggering a run return 202 rather than 201?
choices: Because the request body failed validation
Because the run was accepted and queued for asynchronous execution; its outcome is not known yet
Because 201 cannot carry a JSON body
Because the run replaces an existing run for the same commit

questions.prompt: A client calls `POST .../runs/:runId/cancel` on a run that is already cancelled. What happens?
choices: 200 with the run unchanged, still cancelled with its original finishedAt
404 because cancelled runs are filtered out
200 with finishedAt updated to the current time
All runs of P1, since unknown filters are ignored
An empty list, since no run has that state
